name: Pulsatio Cordis
source:
The popular guy meets a random nobody and inexplicably develops a crush on them. Sound familiar? It’s only the premise of like 90% of the teen fiction genre. But dream no more. Your love letter, once a wishful Hail Mary, has been accepted by the one and only Liev Latané!

Liev seems unattainable 一 how can any sane eighteen-year old juggle being head student with being leader of the debate team and  the school athletics team, on top of being a UN Youth Ambassador? But somehow, out of 150 students, he chose to go on a date with you!

Follow the story of the lucky student Quinn Jones (name changeable) on their date as they do their damndest to impress him with their comparably mediocre credentials. Your every choice matters here… you don't want to ruin your chances with him, do you?

Though Liev appears the epitome of the model student, your date gives you the opportunity to find out more about him. What is he like outside of a school setting? What does he like to do in his free time?

The truth may not be as kind as you expect.

[From [url=https://lucia-lily.itch.io/pulsatio-cordis]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
这个受欢迎的家伙随机遇到了一个无名小卒，并莫名其妙地迷上了他们。听起来很熟悉吗？这只是90% 的青少年小说类型的前提。但不要再做梦了。你的情书，曾经是一厢情愿的万福玛丽，已经被唯一的列维·拉塔内接受了！

列维似乎高不可攀——一个心智健全的十八岁少年，除了担任联合国青年大使之外，如何能同时担任学生长、辩论队和学校体育队的领队呢？但不知怎的，他在150个学生中，选择了和你约会！

跟随幸运的学生奎因·琼斯（化名）在约会时的故事，他们尽最大努力用相对平庸的资历给他留下深刻的印象。你的每一个选择在这里都很重要……你不想毁掉和他在一起的机会，是吗？

尽管列维是模范学生的缩影，但你的约会对象让你有机会更多地了解他。在学校之外他是什么样的？他空闲时间喜欢做什么？

真相也许并不像你想象的那么善良。

[来自[url=https://lucia-lily.itch.io/pulsatio-cordis]itch.io[/url]]
